answer: Because the timing is written down against the tundra challenge, the mirror audit can replay the voyage history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 208 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Repeating the trick 17 times costs 57 separate deposits and 5 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
